name: SuperDepth3D
description: 2D → pseudo-3D depth-buffer-based stereoscopic conversion ReShade shader by Jose Negrete (BlueSkyDefender). At the author's request, Stereopticon does NOT install or configure SuperDepth3D directly — it links users to BlueSkyDefender's GPUSelector app, which manages SuperDepth3D installation with per-game OverWatch profiles. Selecting this tool in Stereopticon opens GPUSelector (installing it on first use) and surfaces a note about following its workflow.
license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0) — see lib/<not-bundled>

redirect.rationale: BlueSkyDefender explicitly asked that Stereopticon point users to GPUSelector rather than re-implementing SuperDepth3D installation logic. GPUSelector handles per-game OverWatch profile management with the author's own tested workflow.

via_gpuselector.notes: Output coverage depends on which SuperDepth3D mode GPUSelector configures for the game. Stereopticon surfaces the available outputs at fix-selection time but defers the actual configuration to GPUSelector.
